title: Already had most items
text: I was hoping that I could receive some items that I don't already have.  I have not received any spectacular items and now I am feeling disappointed.  Everything i have received you can purchase at you local dollar store.  Even the make up is mediocre.  I am going to give it a couple more months them make a decision if I will keep it.  I will come back and update this review as well.
label: negative
